title: Recipe ingredient explosion
prompt: A cake recipe's component breakdown is stored in recipe_components20(parent_id, child_id, qty_per), where qty_per means one batch of parent_id requires qty_per batches of child_id. The root recipe is Cake (id 1). Using a recursive CTE named explosion(component_id, qty) that starts from Cake's direct sub-components and, at each recursive step, multiplies the running quantity by qty_per as it descends the tree, compute the total quantity required of every raw ingredient in the full explosion below the root — summing contributions together whenever an ingredient is reached via more than one path. Return component_id and total_qty (the summed quantity) for every component with id != 1.
setup_sql: CREATE TABLE recipe_components20 (parent_id INTEGER, child_id INTEGER, qty_per INTEGER); INSERT INTO recipe_components20 VALUES (1,2,2),(1,3,1),(2,4,3),(2,5,1),(3,4,1),(3,6,2);
reference_sql: WITH RECURSIVE explosion(component_id, qty) AS (SELECT child_id, qty_per FROM recipe_components20 WHERE parent_id = 1 UNION ALL SELECT rc.child_id, e.qty * rc.qty_per FROM recipe_components20 rc JOIN explosion e ON rc.parent_id = e.component_id) SELECT component_id, SUM(qty) AS total_qty FROM explosion GROUP BY component_id;
